item.description:

Here the changes are applied to the pkgs/by-name/in/incus/package.nix file (for the incus package and not like for master and 26.05 to the pkgs/by-name/in/incus/lts.nix file (for the incus-lts package). This is done to not bump incus on 25.11 beyond 7.0.x to allow users the opportunity to revaluate using stable or LTS package during their 26.05 upgrade.

(The incus-lts package on 25.11 still has the 6.0.x LTS Release.)
